about: Where every data file under tests/fixtures/ and e2e/fixtures/ came from, and its licence. tests/noProtectedChartData.test.ts fails on a data file with no entry, an entry for a file that is gone, or a licence outside the list below, or data that names a proprietary chart as its source. There is no value for protected data: a licensed chart extract cannot be listed, so it cannot be committed (127-C-a, o-charts ruling 2026-10-10).

licences.public-domain: US Government work (NOAA) or otherwise free of copyright
licences.cc-by-4.0: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; the credit below must be shown wherever the data is
licences.odbl: Open Database Licence (OpenStreetMap); credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors
licences.synthetic: made up for the test, by hand or by a script in this repo
licences.own: Thalassa's own data or Shane's own recordings
licences.wmo-res40: WMO Resolution 40 essential data: a partner's observations shared on the WMO Global Telecommunication System for free and unrestricted exchange; the owner is named in the credit
licences.third-party-replace: someone else's data, kept only until the named package replaces it
